title: help
output:
Run your dual-boot Windows install as a VM. Without a command, opens the window

Usage: ws [COMMAND]

Commands:
  setup                Detect Windows, GPUs and CPUs, then configure the VM and boot profiles
  config               Read, check and change config.json as JSON
  define               Validate the host and define the libvirt domain from its current file
  start                Start Windows headlessly, wait for its guest agent and sign in
  launch               Start Windows if needed and show it (Looking Glass in the GPU profile)
  console              Show running Windows without changing its state
  stop                 Request a clean Windows shutdown
  force-stop           Immediately power off the VM
  reboot               Reboot Linux into the normal or GPU boot profile
  looking-glass        Open the Looking Glass client in the GPU profile
  looking-glass-setup  Install the signed Looking Glass virtual display in running Windows
  drivers              Attach the stable Windows guest-driver installer as a CD
…
